freeze.canonical_source_policy: Current checked-in run/ and quality_check/ bytes are canonical.

run.label: run
run.tree_hash_format: sha256(UTF-8 lines: relative_path<TAB>file_sha256<TAB>bytes<LF>, sorted by relative_path using POSIX separators and ordinal Unicode code-point order)

quality_check.label: quality_check
quality_check.tree_hash_format: sha256(UTF-8 lines: relative_path<TAB>file_sha256<TAB>bytes<LF>, sorted by relative_path using POSIX separators and ordinal Unicode code-point order)

legacy_artifact_manifest_audit.policy: Audit only. The checked-in run bytes are canonical; the legacy manifest and raw files are not rewritten.
